name: AccumulateSegmentLengths
evidence: asm; FillPathCurveLengths calls it with (count, points, lengths) and SampleSplineSegment with (20, pts30, len170), each time to fill a running length array from a point array

name: WrapCurveTime
evidence: returns x unchanged when wrap is 0, else adds or subtracts the span (last key minus first key) until x lies between the first and last key times

name: FindPathCurveSegment
evidence: wraps x with WrapCurveTime, scans the key array for the first key above it, and returns the segment index with the offset into the segment and the segment length through lo and hi

name: InterpolatePathCurvePoint
evidence: finds the segment of a parameter in a key array (FindPathCurveSegment) and writes the point blended between the segment's two points and, when asked, the segment's unit direction (the unit x vector for a zero-length one); SamplePathCurveAtTime and SamplePathCurveAtLength call it

name: FindNearestPathCurveSegment
evidence: measures a point against every segment of the curve's points (func_001BA430) and returns the nearest segment and the fraction along it; FindPathCurveNearestPoint calls it

name: WalkToNearestPathCurveSegment
evidence: from a start segment steps forwards or backwards (wrapping when the curve wraps) while the next segment is nearer to the point (func_001BA430), and returns the nearest segment and fraction; ProjectOntoPathCurveNearTime and ProjectOntoPathCurveNearLength call it

name: TransformPointArray
evidence: gets a matrix from func_001891C0 and replaces each of count 16-byte points with func_00188700 of the matrix and the point

name: CreatePathCurve
evidence: allocates 0x1C or 0x1D0 bytes for kind 0 or 1, stores the table D_002176D0 or D_00217708 and the kind, returns 0 for other kinds

name: GetBaseCurveLengthAtTime
evidence: slot 5 of the abstract curve table D_00217568: returns 0

name: GetBaseCurveTimeAtLength
evidence: slot 6 of the abstract curve table D_00217568: returns 0

name: FindPathCurveSegmentByTime
evidence: FindPathCurveSegment over the curve's times array

name: FindPathCurveSegmentByLength
evidence: FindPathCurveSegment over the curve's arc-length array

name: MeasureSplinePathDistance
evidence: original assembly: the function FindSplinePathNearestTime minimises over time (func_001EB168), as MeasurePathCurveDistance is for the path curve

name: GetPathCurveEndTime
evidence: table slot 7: returns the last entry of the times array

name: GetPathCurveEndLength
evidence: table slot 8: returns the last entry of the arc-length array

name: MeasurePathCurveDistance
evidence: samples the curve at the time through its slot 1, then measures that point against the context's two points with func_00186320 and returns the second result; FindPathCurveNearestTime minimises it

name: FindPathCurveNearestTime
evidence: minimises MeasurePathCurveDistance over the curve's times from a start time (func_001EB168, a tenth of the first segment as step, unbounded when it wraps), samples the curve there through slot 1 and returns the time and its length (slot 5); func_001D87C8 calls it

name: GetPathCurveSearchStep
evidence: returns a tenth of the first time interval (times[1]-times[0]); func_0014DBD0 passes it as the step of its parameter search

name: ReadPathCurve
evidence: table slot 0: reads wrap, count, then a time and a 16-byte point per key from the stream into freshly allocated arrays, then calls table slot 9

name: SamplePathCurveAtTime
evidence: slot 1 of the path curve table D_002176D0: interpolates its points (func_0014D280) by its times

name: SamplePathCurveAtLength
evidence: slot 2 of the path curve table D_002176D0: interpolates its points (func_0014D280) by its lengths

name: DrawPathCurveSegment
evidence: transforms the segment's two end points (the last wraps to the first) with func_00188700 and draws the line between them with DrawProjectedLine

name: TransformPathCurvePoints
evidence: table slot 4: passes the curve's count and points to TransformPointArray

name: GetPathCurveLengthAtTime
evidence: table slot 5: finds the segment of a time and linearly blends the arc lengths of its two keys

name: GetPathCurveTimeAtLength
evidence: table slot 6: finds the segment of an arc length and linearly blends the times of its two keys

name: FillPathCurveLengths
evidence: table slot 9: fills the arc-length array from the points with AccumulateSegmentLengths

name: FindPathCurveNearestPoint
evidence: slot 10 of the path curve table D_002176D0: finds the nearest segment and fraction (func_0014D3A8) and returns the time and length there

name: ProjectOntoPathCurveNearTime
evidence: slot 11 of the path curve table D_002176D0: from the segment at the given time (FindPathCurveSegment), finds the nearest point (func_0014D680) and returns its time and length

name: ProjectOntoPathCurveNearLength
evidence: slot 12 of the path curve table D_002176D0: as ProjectOntoPathCurveNearTime, from the segment at the given length

name: ReadSplinePathCurve
evidence: table slot 0 of the kind 1 curve: reads wrap, count, then a time, a point and two tangent vectors per key, calls slot 9 and resets the sample cache

name: ResetSplineSegmentCache
evidence: stores -1 in the cached segment index at 0x1C0

name: SampleSplineSegment
evidence: when a segment is not the cached one, fills 20 samples of it with func_00130B48 and their running lengths with AccumulateSegmentLengths, then caches its index

name: SampleSplinePathAtTime
evidence: original assembly: slot 1 of the spline curve table D_00217708, the counterpart of SamplePathCurveAtTime

name: SampleSplinePathAtLength
evidence: slot 2 of the spline curve table D_00217708: turns the length into a time (slot 6) and samples there through slot 1

name: DrawSplinePathSegment
evidence: original assembly: slot 3 of the spline curve table D_00217708, the counterpart of DrawPathCurveSegment

name: TransformSplinePathPoints
evidence: original assembly: slot 4 of the spline curve table D_00217708, the counterpart of TransformPathCurvePoints

name: GetSplineLengthAtTime
evidence: table slot 5 of kind 1: finds the segment of a time, adds the Hermite length of the part (func_00130C20) to the length at the segment start

name: GetSplineTimeAtLength
evidence: table slot 6 of kind 1: samples the segment of an arc length, locates the length among the 20 sample lengths and blends the segment's key times by the fraction (1/19 steps)

name: FillSplinePathLengths
evidence: table slot 9 of kind 1: sets the first length to 0 and adds the Hermite length of each segment (func_00130C20) to the running total

name: FindSplinePathNearestPoint
evidence: original assembly: slot 10 of the spline curve table D_00217708, the counterpart of FindPathCurveNearestPoint

name: FindSplinePathNearestTime
evidence: slot 11 of the spline curve table D_00217708: minimises MeasureSplinePathDistance over the curve's times from a start time, samples there through slot 1 and returns the time and its length (slot 5)

name: ProjectOntoSplinePathNearLength
evidence: slot 12 of the spline curve table D_00217708: turns the length into a time (slot 6) and calls slot 11 with it
